subject: Video-native annotation
text:
Hi [NAME], 

We recently released our case study: [LINK] with Standard AI, who we helped to save $600k/year by moving to Encord's video-native annotation platform. 

The key reason teams usually move over to Encord is to handle video-native annotation - many other commercial or in-house tools (e.g. Labelbox, V7, CVAT etc) struggle to consistently create labels that are aligned with corresponding frames due to difficulties rendering video in modern web browsers. 

If you'd like to dive deeper into this topic, you can read more about this in our blog post: [LINK] on video label synchronisation.

Let me know if you have any questions & will be happy to help,​

text:
Hi [NAME],

Came across your work at [COMPANY] and thought it would be beneficial to get
in touch.

Our team at Encord built a fully multimodal data development platform for
scaling AI/CV teams. Helping remove bottlenecks in the MLOps process (Data

some of your work. Would you be open to a quick introduction? I'm free next
week if you have any availability.

subject: Working w/ SponsorUnited & Relo Metrics (GumGum)
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I just read [COMPANY]'s case study w/ SageMaker about video segmentation & thought I'd reach out. I lead a computer vision team here at Encord - we're working w/ video-first teams including some of your peers (SponsorUnited, MVPIndex, Relo Metrics (GumGum), etc) to support the fine-tuning of their exiting exposure models (duration, visibility, etc) as well as their expansion into new sports & use cases like E-sports.

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: Working w/ Baker Hughes & Boeing | Computer Vision @ GE
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I just saw your work on computer vision at GE, and thought I'd reach out. I lead a manufacturing & energy computet vision team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we're working with a few of your peers (Baker Hughes, Toyota, Bosch, Siemens, Boeing, etc) to expand into new AI/CV products & scale use cases like automated visual asset inspection, AI-guided borescope inspections, predictive maintenance, quality control in manufacturing, and robotics navigation.

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: Chatted w/ Ju An | Harvard iLabs Alumni
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

I lead a medical imaging team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) - working closely with teams at GE Healthcare, Philips, Perceptive, etc. It seems like my team spoke to Ju An recently & a few things came up that might be worth exploring around visualizing / labeling 3D series & leveraging multimodal data (x-ray, audio/speech, Docs, etc).

Our co-founder [SENDER] & I both began our entrepreneurial journey at the Harvard iLabs so we're always excited to collaborate with companies who started there as well. Would love to get your feedback on what we're building here - would you be open to catch up at some point over the coming weeks? Thursday/Friday generally work best for me.
